points: David told Nathan the prophet that he dwelt in a house of cedars while the ark remained under curtains.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: Nathan first answered that David should do all in his heart, for the Most High was with him.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: That same night the word of the Most High came to Nathan, saying David should not build him a house to dwell in.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: The Most High had gone from tent to tent since bringing Israel up, and had never asked any judge why they had not built him a house of cedar.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: The Most High took David from following the sheep to be ruler over Israel, was with him wherever he went, and cut off his enemies.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: He promised to make David a name like the great men of the earth, to plant Israel in their own place, and to subdue all David's enemies.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: Instead of David building him a house, the Most High declared he would build David a house through his seed after him.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: That son, Solomon, would build the house, and his throne would be established forever; the Most High would not take his mercy from him as he took it from Saul.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: Nathan spoke all these words to David, who sat before the Most High and asked who he was that he should be brought this far.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: David marveled that the Most High regarded him as a man of high degree and did such greatness for his servant's sake.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: David confessed there is none like the Most High and no god beside him, and that no nation is like Israel, whom he went to redeem to be his own people forever.
He recalled the redemption out of Egypt where the Most High made his name great and terrible by driving out nations; Israel is his own people forever and he became their God.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: David prayed that the thing spoken concerning his house be established forever, that the Most High's name be magnified.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 17: The Most High Will Build David a House

points: He asked that the house of his servant be blessed to continue before the Most High forever, for what the Most High blesses shall be blessed forever.
